CCXI 2022's own phase-coverage footnotes, read directly: footnote 2 (一期管网工程...涉及南昌、九江、景德镇、新余、宜春、抚州、鹰潭、上饶等42个县市) places 景德镇 (Jingdezhen -- Leping's home prefecture) AND 上饶 (Shangrao -- Dexing's and Wuyuan's home prefecture) BOTH under PHASE I coverage; footnote 3 (二期管网...涉及井冈山市、莲花县、永新县、大余县等 40个县（市，区）) names none of Jingdezhen's or Shangrao's constituent counties among its Phase II examples. Read plainly, this places Leping/Dexing/Wuyuan's home prefectures under Phase I, not Phase II -- the OPPOSITE of how I initially read the relaunch note's parenthetical summary of this same finding. Independently, and going beyond what the note flagged: THREE separate, differently-hosted, differently-classed primary sources all name this exact project '一期' (Phase I) directly, not Phase II: (1) jxnews.com.cn 2020-12-10 municipal news, title and body: '江西省天然气管网一期乐平—德兴—婺源支线项目开工建设'; (2) jxganan.com 2024-04-28 official 安全验收评价 (safety-acceptance evaluation), title: '...江西省天然气网一期工程乐平-德兴-婺源支线项目（乐平-德兴支线）'; (3) yingdodo.com 2018-05-25 contractor project-reference listing: '项目名称：江西**然气管网一期乐平-德兴-婺源支线工程'. All three also name the operator as 江西省天然气管道有限公司 (the Phase I JV entity per CCXI's own footnote 1: '天然气管道公司负责投资建设及运营承接川气东送气源的一期管网'), not the Phase II 管道分公司. This is a well-corroborated, multi-source, segment-level naming finding that directly contradicts this row's current segment_name label ('Jiangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Network, Phase II, Leping-Dexing-Wuyuan'). I have NOT renamed the row or altered PipelineName/segment_name (out of this shard's scope -- I only resolve owed_fills/[ref] cells). Recommend Update review rename/reclassify this row from Phase II to Phase I, consistent with every segment-naming source found. This also means the Owner/Operator attribution staged above (54%/46% JV split) is the evidentially-correct one for THIS row, contrary to what the default Phase-II-segment rule (RELAUNCH_NOTES item 2) would otherwise prescribe -- applied carefully here per that item's own instruction to 'decide which phase YOUR segment belongs to from a naming source' rather than mechanically defaulting.
